title: Roadmap Runner State
description: Canonical state for /roadmap-runner sessions. Lives at dev/<roadmap-slug>/runner-state.json. The roadmap doc itself is a human-readable projection; this file is the source of truth the runner reads on resume and updates after every transition.

roadmap_path.description: Repo-root-relative path to the roadmap doc (e.g. docs/roadmaps/<slug>.md).

roadmap_slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for the roadmap, used for state paths (dev/<roadmap_slug>/...).

spec_path.description: Optional path to the upstream spec the roadmap was distilled from. Forwarded to /adversarial-review-plan for each child plan when present.

status.description: initializing = parsing roadmap, building plan list. running = a child plan is in flight (planning, implementing, or demo). paused_for_human = waiting on a human gate (plan approval, demo verification, or auto_advance=false hold between plans). blocked = a child plan or runner action requires human input that the runner cannot resolve autonomously (see blocker). complete = all child plans complete. aborted = human or fatal error halted the run.

auto_advance.description: If true, the runner advances to the next plan automatically after demo verification. If false (default), the runner pauses and asks the human after each plan. Independent of in-plan human gates (plan approval, blocker resolution, demo verification) which are always required.

current_plan_slug.description: Slug of the plan currently being worked on. Null when initializing, between plans (auto_advance=false), or complete.

child_plans.description: Per-plan state, ordered as in the roadmap §4. Updated after every transition; mirror of the roadmap doc's Status lines.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case identifier; matches the slug in the roadmap doc and is used for downstream paths (docs/plans/plan-<slug>.md, dev/<slug>/, feature branches).

status.description: Per-plan status. Mirrored to the roadmap doc's Status: line on every change.

plan_path.description: Repo-root-relative path to the plan file (e.g. docs/plans/plan-<slug>.md). May not exist yet if status=not_started.

depends_on.description: Slugs of plans this plan depends on. Runner refuses to dispatch this plan until all deps are status=complete.

exit_demo.description: The exit demo description from §4 of the roadmap. Surfaced verbatim to the human at the demo verification gate.

plan_approved_at.description: When the human approved the /adversarial-review-plan output.

agentic_dev_completed_at.description: When agentic-dev returned success (before demo verification).

demo_verified_at.description: When the human confirmed the exit demo passed.

agentic_dev_resume_count.description: How many times the runner has re-spawned agentic-dev for this plan after resolving a bubbled-up blocker. Used to detect runaway resume loops.

child_state_path.description: Path to the agentic-dev state.json for this plan (e.g. dev/<slug>/state.json). Set when implementing begins.

blocker.description: Active blocker that paused the runner. Cleared on resolution. Null when status != blocked.

type.description: What kind of human input the runner is waiting on. needs_plan_approval = /adversarial-review-plan converged, awaiting human OK to feed to /agentic-dev. needs_decision_for_* = a sub-skill (adversarial-review-plan or agentic-dev) hit a blocker requiring human input. needs_demo_verification = agentic-dev returned success; runner asks human to verify the exit demo. needs_merge_approval = agentic-dev's final_merge_policy=human_required gate. needs_advance_decision = auto_advance=false; runner asks human whether to begin the next plan. agentic_dev_* = budget/loop/failure conditions surfaced from agentic-dev's state.json. factual_drift_in_predecessor = runner detected that a predecessor plan's claims no longer match the codebase (e.g. a file was renamed).

child_plan_slug.description: Which child plan triggered the blocker, if applicable.

child_state_path.description: Path to the agentic-dev or adversarial-review-plan state file the runner read to derive the blocker.

summary.description: Human-readable description of what input is needed. The runner surfaces this to the user via AskUserQuestion.

options.description: If the blocker has discrete choices, list them here so AskUserQuestion can render them as options.

resolution.description: What the human chose / wrote. The runner writes this to the appropriate artifact (DECISIONS.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, the roadmap doc, etc.) before clearing the blocker.

resolution_target_path.description: Where the runner wrote the resolution (e.g. dev/<child-slug>/DECISIONS.md, the roadmap's Status line for the affected plan).
